description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Torentify is seeking a Quality Assurance professional to support testing of web-based applications. The role contributes to test planning, design, and execution, validates functionality and business requirements, and identifies defects while providing testing and troubleshooting support.
Software Test Engineer supporting web application and API testing through planning, execution, defect tracking, and database queries

Responsibilities:
• Contribute to test design, test planning, and test execution as an individual team member
• Test web-based applications using browser developer tools
• Work with product management and development teams to understand business requirements and technical specifications
• Interact regularly with clients to understand business scenarios and provide testing and troubleshooting support
• Develop test plans, test cases, and other testing documentation
• Identify, document, and track defects while following the defect management process
• Test APIs and use browser developer tools to validate API request and response data
• Write basic database queries to support testing activities
• Analyze technical problems, gather relevant information, establish facts, and draw logical conclusions
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support application quality and testing deliverables
• Manage testing activities while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced startup environment

Requirements:
• 1–3 years of relevant Quality Assurance technical experience
• Experience participating in test design, planning, and execution
• Experience working in an Agile/Scrum team
• Hands-on experience testing web-based applications
• Familiarity with browser developer tools
• Experience working with APIs and validating request and response data
• Ability to write basic database queries
• Experience preparing test plans, test cases, and related testing artifacts
• Understanding of defect management processes
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
• Clear written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to collaborate with product teams, developers, clients, and other stakeholders
• Ability to manage deadlines and deliverables effectively

Preferred:
• Bachelor of Science (BS) or Bachelor of Arts (BA) degree preferred
• Knowledge of the health insurance domain is a significant advantage
• Advanced SQL and relational database knowledge is a plus
• Familiarity with performance testing concepts and tools is beneficial
• United States work authorization preferred
